name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🌱 New to bees? The welcome now asks how long you've kept bees. New beekeepers get short tips in each inspection and a "this time of year" card on Home. Change it in Settings › What the app shows.
👑 Queen cells: say or tap where they are, how many and their state, and Wingman tells you what kind they probably are, when she'll come out, and when to look for eggs.
🌤️ Mating weather: when you find queen cells, the hive page shows which days look good for her mating flights, and can put the dates on your phone's calendar.
📦 Nucs of 3 or 2 frames, mini mating nucs and queen castles, drawn to scale.
💊 Log a treatment or feeding for the entire yard at once.
🟫 Brood pattern: solid, spotty or didn't look, with "Why spotty brood?" on the hive page.
📊 On a computer, the website has a Dashboard where you can make everyday changes that go to your phone (when signed in).
✅ A Getting started list on Home, a 1-minute practice with Buddy, ❓ help on each screen, and a feedback button in Help & questions.
🐛 Mite counts now follow the time of year: treat at 6 or more mites in 300 bees from April to October, 3 or more from November to March. Or set your own levels in Settings › When to treat for mites.
